title: Fix bugs in a Go integer calculator
description: Brownfield Go dirty_cleanup: fix three intentional bugs in integer calculator functions (Power uses multiplication instead of exponentiation, Factorial computes wrong base case, Gcd uses wrong algorithm).

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in intcalc.go.

Bug 1 — Power: returns base * exp instead of base^exp.
  Fix: use a loop to multiply base by itself exp times:
    result := 1
    for i := 0; i < exp; i++ { result *= base }
    return result

Bug 2 — Factorial: base case returns 0 instead of 1.
  Fix: change `return 0` to `return 1`

Bug 3 — Gcd: custom subtraction loop is fragile; use the standard modulo algorithm.
  Fix: replace loop body with: a, b = b, a%b

All 5 tests must pass.
Run: go test ./...
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `go test ./...` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
